MDLZ.summary: Helen of Troy Limited (HELE) reported Q2 adjusted EPS of 79 cents, beating estimates by 55%, with net sales rising 2.1% to $440.9 million. The company raised its fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guidance to $3.60-$4.15 and free cash flow forecast to $120-$140 million, driven by strength in Home & Outdoor segment, favorable tariff refunds, and lower debt levels.

MDLZ.title: Zacks Industry Outlook Mondelez, Conagra Brands, The Chefs' Warehouse and Mama's Creations
MDLZ.summary: The Food-Miscellaneous industry faces challenging conditions driven by elevated living costs, cautious consumer spending, and demand for value-oriented products. Despite persistent cost pressures and uneven foodservice demand, companies are investing in innovation and operational efficiencies. Four stocks highlighted include Chefs' Warehouse (Strong Buy), Mondelez and Mama's Creations (Buy), and Conagra (Hold), with the industry ranked #210 out of 247 Zacks industries, indicating dull near-term prospects.

MDLZ.title: Can Monaco's Expanding Footprint Drive Molson Coors' Revenues?
MDLZ.summary: Molson Coors (TAP) acquired Monaco Cocktails through Atomic Brands to expand in the ready-to-drink spirits category. Monaco's first full quarter showed sales and profits ahead of expectations, with presence in five states offering significant expansion potential. Both Monaco and Fever-Tree are on track to contribute 1-2% of TAP's net sales. TAP stock trades at a discount valuation (7.68X forward P/E vs. industry average 14.18X) but has underperformed its sector over six months.

MDLZ.title: Can Mondelez Scale Biscoff Into a Bigger Global Growth Platform?
MDLZ.summary: Mondelez International is successfully expanding its Biscoff brand across biscuits and chocolate categories in Europe and India. The Marabou Biscoff chocolate launch captured 7% market share in Sweden within weeks, while Biscoff biscuits in India are exceeding internal projections. The company is increasing brand investments and innovation efforts to drive consumer trials and establish Biscoff as a global growth platform.

COIN.title: Coinbase-Samsung Deal Expands USDC Access Through Samsung Wallet
COIN.summary: Coinbase Global is partnering with Samsung to bring USD Coin (USDC) to Samsung Wallet users in the U.S. starting late October 2026, leveraging Coinbase Prime for subcustody. Average USDC balances in Coinbase products reached a record $20 billion in Q2 2026, up 44% year-over-year. While the partnership could expand USDC adoption and support Coinbase's custody and payments business, earnings growth depends on sustained customer activity and transaction volumes.

RHHBY.title: Roche presents new Phase III one-year data for vamikibart in uveitic macular edema (UME), a serious cause of vision loss
RHHBY.summary: Roche announced one-year Phase III data from MEERKAT and SANDCAT studies showing vamikibart, an anti-IL-6 monoclonal antibody, demonstrated sustained vision improvements and macular thickness reductions in uveitic macular edema patients. The FDA has accepted Roche's Biologics License Application with an approval decision expected by July 2027. If approved, vamikibart would be the first non-steroid targeted treatment for UME, potentially establishing a new standard of care.

RHHBY.title: Roche Gets FDA Approval for Another Label Expansion of Tecentriq
RHHBY.summary: Roche received FDA approval for Tecentriq in combination with chemotherapy for adjuvant treatment of stage III deficient DNA mismatch repair (dMMR) colon cancer. The phase III ATOMIC study demonstrated a 50% reduction in recurrence or death risk, with 86% disease-free survival at 36 months versus 76% for chemotherapy alone. This marks Tecentriq's 12th U.S. indication and positions it as the first approved adjuvant immunotherapy for this cancer type.

RHHBY.title: Next Generation Antibody Therapeutics Market, 2nd Edition: Global Industry Trends and Forecast to 2035 | Immunocytokines and Combination Therapies Drive Growth
RHHBY.summary: The global next generation antibody therapeutics market is projected to grow from USD 5.45 billion to USD 5.76 billion by 2035, with a modest 1% CAGR. Growth is driven by advances in biotechnology, targeted treatments, and expanding clinical pipelines for cancer, rare diseases, and cardiovascular conditions. Immunocytokines and combination therapies are expected to demonstrate the strongest growth potential, while North America is projected to maintain approximately 64% market share.

TLRY.title: CRON Stock Rises 17% in Three Months: Time to Buy the Dip or Cash Out?
TLRY.summary: Cronos Group shares rose 17% over three months following better-than-expected Q2 2026 results, with first-half revenues up 49% to $98.2 million driven by Canadian market share gains and international expansion. However, the company faces challenges including potentially unsustainable margin improvements, an Israeli anti-dumping investigation, and intensifying European competition from rivals like Village Farms and Tilray. Analysts maintain a cautious stance with unchanged earnings estimates.

LMT.title: Can Lockheed Martin's Training Solutions Expand Its Defense Business?

CSCO.summary: Cisco Systems closed fiscal 2026 with $9.3 billion in hyperscaler AI infrastructure orders, a 4.5x increase from fiscal 2025. The company expects hyperscaler AI revenues to reach $7.5 billion in fiscal 2027, up from $4 billion. Networking product orders rose 40% year-over-year in Q4 fiscal 2026, marking the eighth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. Security revenues increased 14% year-over-year, with firewall orders growing over 30% for the second consecutive quarter. Cisco projects fiscal 2027 revenues of $72.2-$73.4 billion with non-GAAP earnings of $5.05-$5.11 per share.

EDIT.title: EDIT Set to Begin First-in-Human Study in Hypercholesterolemia
EDIT.summary: Editas Medicine announced approval to initiate the Strive phase I/II clinical study of EDIT-401, an investigational in vivo gene-editing therapy for heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH) in Australia. The single-dose therapy demonstrated approximately 90% or greater reductions in atherogenic lipoproteins in preclinical primate studies. Patient dosing is planned for 2026 with initial safety data expected in Q1 2027.

PPG.title: PPG Invests $70 Million to Expand Aerospace Operations in Huntsville
PPG.summary: PPG Industries announced a $70 million investment to expand its aerospace transparencies operations in Huntsville, Alabama. The investment is driven by rising demand for aircraft cockpit and passenger windows across commercial, military, and general aviation markets.

MLYS.title: Mineralys Therapeutics Presents New Data for Lorundrostat at the American Heart Association Hypertension Scientific Sessions 2026
MLYS.summary: Mineralys Therapeutics presented new clinical trial data for lorundrostat, its investigational aldosterone synthase inhibitor for treating difficult-to-treat hypertension. The Launch-HTN trial showed 46% of participants achieved AHA/ACC guideline systolic blood pressure targets (<130 mmHg) at 12 weeks, with over two-thirds achieving ≥10 mmHg reduction. The Explore-OSA trial demonstrated clinically meaningful morning blood pressure reductions in obstructive sleep apnea patients with no adverse effects on sleep apnea indices.
